Your rate will depend on your seniority level, skills, and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers and other specialists.

The opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager for our Growth Operations team to build and scale the marketing technology and automation layer powering Urban Sports Club's B2C growth.
This role sits at the intersection of CRM, marketing technology, and data activation, with a primary focus on enabling and scaling our CRM infrastructure while extending its impact across paid acquisition, product, and partnerships.
You will act as the system owner and enabler, ensuring our tools, automation, and data are fully leveraged to drive efficient, personalized, and scalable growth.

You own the CRM infrastructure, optimizing Braze for scalability, lifecycle automation, and personalization
You build and scale automated CRM and marketing workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

You manage and integrate the MarTech stack, establishing best practices, governance, and scalable processes
You drive AI adoption by implementing use cases that enhance CRM, content creation, workflows, and personalization

What you will need to succeed
You have 4–7+ years of experience in MarTech, CRM Operations, or Marketing Operations
You have hands-on experience with Braze, Segment, or similar CRM and customer data platforms
You have a strong understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lifecycle marketing
You have experience working with marketing data, audience segmentation, and customer activation
You have a solid technical foundation, including APIs, integrations, and data flows.
You bring a problem-solving mindset with a focus on scalability, efficiency, and process optimization
You are passionate about applying AI to improve marketing workflows, automation, and personalization

Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.

We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and grow the top of our marketplace funnel.
Aroundhome is a two-sided marketplace platform where the possibility of shared success begins with the match: the moment a homeowner is connected with the right partner. The House Owner & Service Request Acquisition domain owns everything upstream of that match.

It starts when a homeowner discovers Aroundhome through search or content, continues as they describe their home project, and ends when a qualified service request is handed to matching.

The quality of that request shapes the experience on both sides of the marketplace, so acquisition volume, conversion, and data quality are all part of your responsibility.
At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping the success of Germany's leading housing project platform. We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.
As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.
You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You actively rally those around you toward this vision.
You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.
You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.
You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.
You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.
You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.
You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.
Skills
You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.
You are experienced in optimizing complex user funnels and conversion flows, using experimentation (A/B testing) and data to improve conversion, quality, and user trust while laying the foundation for long-term platform engagement.
You apply strong analytical thinking and product analytics skills to define success measures, interpret data, uncover insights, and guide evidence-based decisions that improve homeowner and business outcomes.
You bring a strong technical affinity to help shape our underlying acquisition and conversion architecture. You understand the concepts of data models or taxonomies and have enough grasp of APIs and data flows to reason about feasibility and sequencing with engineers.
You work with LLMs as a natural part of your daily practice and can show concretely how they strengthen your discovery, analysis, and delivery. Ideally, you have taken AI beyond personal productivity and understand how scalable AI solutions reach production-grade features, for example through prompt chains, LLM-supported data extraction, or automated qualification flows.
You bring order into chaos by bringing together diverse perspectives, challenges, and priorities to establish shared understanding and strong alignment across teams, and you are comfortable chairing decisions no single team owns.
You think entrepreneurially and achieve your goals with a high degree of responsibility and ownership.
You follow the latest trends in product management and technology, are an absolute team player, and your excellent communication skills in English and German, along with a good sense of humor, characterize you.

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.
Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.
Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.
Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.
Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

We are building a SaaS platform that packages Autodesk Consulting’s intellectual property — proven workflows, implementation guidance, learning content, and tooling recommendations — into a scalable digital experience that connects customers and internal Autodesk consultants to the knowledge they need to drive successful digital transformation. This is a platform built at the intersection of knowledge management, content delivery, and AI-assisted discovery, and it is evolving rapidly.
As Senior Principal Product Manager, you will own the full platform — the foundation on which our Solutions, Services, and advisory experiences are built.

You will define and drive the product vision and roadmap, work directly with lead architects and engineering teams across India and Poland, partner closely with our UI/UX designer, and collaborate with Product Owners who manage sprint-level delivery across multiple scrum teams.

You will also serve as the connective tissue between three critical stakeholder groups: the customers and Autodesk consultants who use the platform daily, and the Solutions and Services PMs who have a stake in how their content and services are experienced and consumed.
This is a role for someone who is energized by building. The platform is new, the market opportunity is significant, and the roadmap reflects that ambition. The person in this role will thrive on creating structure in a fast-moving environment, making high-quality decisions with incomplete information, and shaping a product that is still defining what it can become.

Own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platform, balancing near-term delivery with long-term platform integrity
Define and drive the AI-assisted discovery and personalization strategy that enables customers and consultants to find relevant workflows, solutions, and knowledge based on their specific context
Partner with lead architects and senior engineers across globally distributed teams to translate product strategy into technical direction
Work with Product Owners to ensure roadmap priorities are effectively executed across multiple scrum teams
Collaborate with Solutions and Services PMs to ensure platform capabilities effectively support content delivery and service consumption experiences
Develop deep understanding of the needs of both external customers and internal Autodesk consultants, and translate those needs into platform features and experiences
Define and track success metrics that reflect both platform health and the business outcomes the platform is designed to drive
Navigate a complex stakeholder environment, building alignment across consulting leadership, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams
Contribute to the commercialization strategy, helping define how the platform creates and captures value over time

10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex, multi-stakeholder products
Demonstrated experience building AI-enabled applications, particularly in the areas of intelligent search, contextual discovery, recommendation systems, or personalization
Experience building products that span SaaS applications, content platforms, and service delivery — not just traditional software features
Proven ability to operate effectively in early-stage or rapidly evolving product environments where structure and clarity must be created, not inherited
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage meaningfully with architects and engineers on system design, data architecture, and AI/ML approaches
Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority at a senior level
Nice to have: experience building content lifecycle management products, particularly those involving structured, hierarchical, or reusable content — including authoring, publishing workflows, versioning, and change propagation
AI/ML frameworks and application patterns, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, semantic search, and large language model integration
Modern SaaS platform architecture and API-driven product design
Content management and knowledge management systems
Content lifecycle management tooling, including structured authoring environments, library management, and publishing workflows
Analytics and data pipeline tooling
Agile delivery methodologies and experience working with Product Owners across multiple scrum teams
The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate has built products where an intelligent discovery layer is the differentiator — where the ability to surface the right knowledge, in the right context, for the right user is what makes the product worth using. They understand what it takes to make that experience feel effortless, and they bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully with engineers and architects on how to build it.
They are comfortable in the ambiguity of a brand new product. They don’t need a mature backlog or a well-worn playbook — they can create structure where none exists, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and keep a complex roadmap moving without losing sight of the long-term vision.
They think in systems. They understand that a platform serving customers, internal consultants, and peer product managers simultaneously requires architectural thinking, not just feature thinking.
They are a natural connector. In a role that sits at the center of platform, solutions, and services, they build trust quickly, communicate with clarity, and have a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders around a shared direction.
A candidate who also brings experience with content lifecycle management — structured authoring, library systems, versioning, and hierarchical content relationships — would bring a rare and particularly valuable perspective to this role.

Since our inception in 2014, we’ve scaled to a $2 billion valuation and gained a presence in 6 countries globally - Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK and Canada. We now service over 300,000 businesses and more than 2 million employees.
The EH Way
At Employment Hero, we’re proud of our unique DNA, which we call The EH Way.
We are Mission First - everything we do (from what we work on, to how we allocate capital and where we focus) is driven by our Mission
We are Remote First - we champion a remote environment with a preference for asynchronous communication and a high degree of autonomy
We are AI First - we are committed to using AI to accelerate our mission; AI is not just a tool, it’s a fundamental part of how we operate, innovate, and scale
We are Apolitical - we do not take a position on political or social topics, unless it relates to our Mission
We Live by Our Values - we role model our values 100% of the time
We Expect High Performance - we set a high standard and we’re not satisfied with being average
This role
This role will be hyper-focused on the payroll aspect of our product, specifically building the infrastructure and feature set to support small and medium-sized businesses. We offer an all-in-one solution with a hub-and-spoke modular product. One of the key spokes of our product offering is payroll, which includes facilitating payments, keeping records, and calculating and remitting taxes.
In addition, supporting decision-makers with critical data and analytics is key for further unlocking areas of innovation across all pillars (HR, Payroll, Benefits, and Scheduling).
Be responsible for product delivery, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and cross-functional coordination.
Define the scope of development for new product features and ongoing feature enhancements.
Write and prioritize epics, user stories, and define acceptance criteria.
Establish and maintain a high level of credibility with internal and external stakeholders.
Leverage your analytical ability to back your decisions with data.
Effectively use data and analytics layered against high-quality user research to inform the direction of the product line.
Be responsible for tracking progress, assessing risks, coordinating delivery, and actively communicating contingency and mitigation plans for the team.
You will run various ad-hoc research and business analyses to assess opportunities and risks.

LocationOur Principal Technical Product Owner - DoiT PartnerOps will be an integral part of our Product Management team. This role is based remotely in the East US, Canada, the UK or Ireland. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity We’re hiring a Principal Technical Product Owner to drive the strategy, rapid delivery, and iteration for the DoiT Partner Platform. This platform enables cloud partners, resellers, and service providers to operate, monetize, and scale their cloud businesses across major hyperscalers.

The platform is designed to help partners manage the operational and financial complexity of the cloud ecosystem, including cloud billing, margin management, customer lifecycle workflows, and partner-led service delivery. This senior role is built for a leader with a "technical founder" mindset.

You will act as the tip of the spear for all DoiT Partner Platform initiatives , serving as a leader amongst the product team to guide the broader product vision and set the standard for execution.

You will bring relentless curiosity about how the cloud ecosystem works, a deep understanding of hyperscaler partner programs, and the confidence to test ideas directly with domain experts.

The right leader will have held hands-on roles within the cloud ecosystem—such as cloud operations, cloud billing / FinOps, or partner operations—and will bring direct experience working with channel business models.

In addition to hands-on execution, you will help direct strategy, align cross-functional teams, and mentor other technical product owners across the organization. Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Delivery
Act as the "tip of the spear" for the DoiT Partner Platform: Serve as the foremost product authority and a leader amongst peers, driving alignment across multiple product squads and setting the bar for product excellence.
Own the overarching strategy, delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for major platform components.
Partner with VP-level leadership to define strategic direction, translating it into clear problems to solve and shippable scope.
Direct and mentor other Technical Product Owners to elevate product management practices, ensuring cohesive execution across the entire platform portfolio.
Drive the feedback loop across teams: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
Review technical designs, reason about complex tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer.
Deep Partner & Ecosystem Understanding
Leverage your hands-on experience within the cloud ecosystem and understanding of channel, reseller, and partner business models.
Develop deep empathy for the workflows of cloud partners: billing operations, margin management, reseller customer management, support operations, and service delivery.
Use direct partner conversations and operational insight to identify friction, gaps, and strategic opportunities to improve how partners run their cloud businesses.
Cloud Billing & Partner Operations Expertise
Bring strong understanding of cloud billing constructs, marketplace programs, margin models, and partner incentives across hyperscalers.
Help shape complex platform capabilities that manage or abstract complexity in areas such as:

Multi-cloud billing aggregation.
Partner margin and discount models.
Customer invoicing and revenue operations.
Usage and cost transparency.
Marketplace and private offer workflows.

Executive & Partner Validation
Speak frequently with key partners (aiming for 3–5 conversations a week) and internal stakeholders to validate ideas, refine workflows, and test assumptions.
Engage deeply with executive stakeholders at cloud partners, MSPs, SIs, and resellers to understand how they operate their cloud businesses.
Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into strategic decisions, and explain "why" in a way that builds trust and consensus among peers and leadership.
Engineering-Embedded Technical Product Ownership
Operate as a core leader working closely with Engineering leaders—present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning—ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
Ensure components are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior, supporting partner-grade reliability and scalability.
Quality, Outcomes, Trust & Governance
Define what “success” means for the platform portfolio with clear metrics (partner adoption, onboarding speed, billing accuracy, workflow completion, retention, reliability signals, partner-reported impact).
Instrument learning: ensure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into portfolio prioritization.
Ensure platform capabilities account for the operational realities of the cloud partner ecosystem, including billing accuracy, financial reconciliation, and auditability.

Extensive product leadership experience with 10+ years of direct experience in the cloud ecosystem, ideally across roles such as cloud operations, FinOps, partner operations, or building platforms that serve cloud customers or partners.
Proven ability to act as a "player-coach"—driving high-level strategy, executing hands-on alongside engineering, and directing/mentoring other product owners as a respected peer leader.
Strong experience with cloud billing systems, cost and usage data, or revenue operations within cloud environments.
Deep understanding of the cloud partner ecosystem (resellers, MSPs, SIs, distributors, marketplaces). Candidates have likely worked within the partner ecosystem at some point in their careers.
Experience building or operating platforms that serve channel or partner-driven business models.
Strong product sense for turning messy operational problems into clear scope and shipped value with an excellent user experience.
Technical fluency in cloud fundamentals and APIs across AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Azure.
Coding experience is a plus—enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
Must have demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate product specifications and development.

· Act as the lead SME for demand planning processes, ensuring best practices and continuous improvement.
· Lead and support demand planning system implementations and enhancement projects, ensuring alignment with business needs.
· Collaborate with key stakeholders, including operations, procurement, logistics, and IT, to understand business objectives and translate them into product requirements. Requirements Management:

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal.

The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved. What you'll be doing
Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.
Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.
Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.
Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.
Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.
Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.
Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.
What you'll need
Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.
Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.
Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).
AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.
Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
Outcomes
Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap
Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch
Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds
AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted
Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged
Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Japan. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Japan. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1.

Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

Drive the product evolution by applying a strict commercial ROI lens to all decisions—evaluating opportunity costs, resource estimation, and real business value rather than just gut feeling.
The MVP Mindset: Ruthlessly prioritize and define what "Minimum Viable" means for feature prototypes. Convincingly strip away nice-to-haves to test core hypotheses cheaply, validating player retention and monetization as quickly as possible.
Fast Monetization Design: Focus heavily on hybrid-casual monetization mechanics. Drive product strategies integrating early subscription funnels, automated pop-ups, and powerful emotional or visual triggers (cosmetics, exclusive drops, impulse-buys) instead of heavy, slow-burn mid-core systems.

Pure Product Focus: Dedicate your energy to analyzing systems, drafting feature concepts, and maximizing impact. You will not be bogged down by sprint planning, retros, or daily agile team coordination—those processes are managed entirely by our Production and Project Management team.

Calculated Risk-Taker: Experience working in a fast-paced "fail fast, learn faster" exploration culture, with the ability to launch early, iterate rapidly, and ruthlessly "kill your darlings" when the math doesn't add up.
Monetization Instincts: Deep understanding of modern hybrid economies, early subscription funnels, and e-commerce psychology (retention, conversion, instant consumption hooks) that drive high player value.
Cross-Functional Generalist: An agile communicator who can align seamlessly with Data Scientists on ROI calculations, UA managers on campaign scaling, and Artists/Designers on player-centered UI flows.

Run A/B and multivariate tests across registration screens, pricing displays, plan framing, onboarding steps, and upsell surfaces.
Develop strategic growth initiatives beyond incremental optimization

Bring customer psychology to your decision-making: understand what motivates parents to start, what creates hesitation, and how to design flows that build confidence at each step.
Write sharp, actionable product requirements that unblock engineering rather than constrain it.
Work in an agile environment with a dedicated pod: maintaining high execution velocity while managing Legal and Compliance review in a regulated industry.

Invicti is looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager to own our Code & Developer Security product area - spanning SAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, and Secrets Detection. This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build products that security and engineering teams actually trust: better signal, less noise, faster fixes. These products will be a significant part of the Invicti AppSec Platform.

AI is changing how software gets written, and it's changing this product area faster than almost any other. Development teams using AI coding assistants are shipping more code, faster, with less visibility into what's in it.

That means larger attack surfaces, more opaque dependency chains, more auto-generated IaC, and secrets in places no one reviewed. The tools that win in this environment won't just scan more, they'll surface what actually matters, with enough context that a developer can act on it without filing a ticket.
At the same time, Invicti 's portfolio is expanding. Our recently delivered ASPM platform creates a correlation layer above individual scan results. Octo, our agentic offensive security capability, is beginning to close the loop between static findings and validated exploitability. The Code Security product area sits at the foundation of this stack, and this PM will shape how those connections get built.

Full product ownership for the Code Security product area, SAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, and Secrets Detection, across the Invicti and Acunetix product lines
Roadmap definition and prioritization grounded in customer evidence, market data, and portfolio strategy.
A point of view on how AI-assisted development changes the threat model, and how our scanning, triage, and remediation capabilities need to evolve in response
Positioning in a highly competitive market that includes incumbents and a growing set of AI-native entrants rethinking what static analysis can do

5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a technical PM role at a security, developer tools, or infrastructure company desired
Familiarity with at least two of the core domains: SAST, SCA, IaC security, container security, or secrets management
A perspective on how AI-assisted development changes the security problem
Strong written communication
Experience working in a multi-product environment where roadmap decisions require cross-portfolio thinking

Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default
Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!
We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here !

Join the team working on the Mail & Calendar ecosystem alongside 50 Engineers

Advancing the frontiers of cryptography to ensure user data remains secure even in the face of emerging technologies such as quantum proof encryption.

Pushing the boundaries of innovation with projects like Scribe, the world's first private AI in a consumer product.

Du stehst im laufenden Austausch mit unabhängigen Vermögensberater:innen, holst kontinuierlich Feedback ein und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete Produktverbesserungen.
Du stellst sicher, dass Produktfunktionen spezifikationsgerecht, in hoher Qualität und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
Du beobachtest die Leistung bestehender Funktionen und der zugrunde liegenden Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für technische Optimierungen und UX-Verbesserungen.
Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei.

Du bringst mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Software-Engineering mit, idealerweise im Fintech- oder Start-up-Umfeld.

Du kennst dich sehr gut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum sowie dem gesamten Software-Entwicklungszyklus aus.

Du kommunizierst sicher und transparent innerhalb deines Teams, unternehmensweit (auch mit CTO und CEO) sowie mit externen Stakeholdern und Berater:innen.
Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (mindestens C1), da der laufende Austausch mit deutschen Vermögensberater:innen ein zentraler Teil deiner Rolle ist, sowie fließend Englisch.
Du lebst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und kannst mindestens 60 % deiner Arbeitszeit in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main verbringen.

Hohes Maß an Autonomie und die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management-Team aktiv mitzugestalten.
Ein dynamisches, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und einer "Get-things-done"-Mentalität.
Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit einem attraktiven, erfolgsorientierten Bonussystem, gekoppelt an deine Partnership-Meilensteine.

Hybrides Arbeiten (60 % vor Ort) und flexible Arbeitszeiten.

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier.
By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier.
Now, we’re scaling fast and building the next generation of products to accelerate the green energy transition.

From making it effortless to switch to heat pumps, solar and EVs, to launching smart tariffs and creating renewable generation at scale, we’re solving some of the most complex challenges in energy with speed, creativity and customer obsession.

We’re also enabling our global businesses to reach the full capability of what we’ve achieved in the UK, taking the learnings, products and experiences that customers love here and rolling them out worldwide.

Our mobile app is how millions of customers interact with Octopus every day. It's global first, lives across multiple countries, and is growing fast.We need a Product Manager who can own the product direction for key areas of the app, navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, and ship features that genuinely make customers' lives easier.
This is a role where you’ll be fully embedded with engineers and designers, shaping what we build and how we build it. You'll coordinate across country teams, balancing local needs with a global product vision. And you'll do it at startup pace, because even though we're big now, we still move like we're small.
At Octopus Tech, you'll have real ownership, variety, and the chance to shape products that make a tangible difference in people's lives: lowering bills, enabling greener living, and delivering experiences customers genuinely love. You'll work side by side with teams across marketing, operations, and data, and see the impact of your work in the real world, fast.
What you’ll be doing…
Owning the product roadmap for your area of the mobile app, setting direction and making the calls on what gets built and when.
Coordinating across Octopus's global markets. Our app serves customers in multiple countries, so you'll navigate competing priorities, align stakeholders, and find the right balance between local needs and global consistency.
Working closely with engineers, designers, and data teams to define problems, shape solutions, and ship iteratively.
Defining technical requirements for dependencies on other teams and clearly communicating priority to external teams.
Developing, testing, and releasing features with scalability in mind.
Scoping larger underlying system changes and making pragmatic decisions about sequencing.
Monitoring existing customer journeys and new releases, using data to drive decisions and catch issues early.
Collaborating with local Operations teams to test changes and debug issues with live journeys.
Regular touchpoints with Marketing to identify trends, issues or improvements across funnels.
Working across multiple teams (Marketing, Ops, Credit, Design, country leads) to build shared understanding and drive alignment.
What you'll have...
3+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent working on mobile apps.
Experience in startups or fast-moving scale-ups where you've had to figure things out without a rigid playbook.
A track record of shipping mobile products that real people use and love.
The ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders, teams, and geographies without losing momentum.
Real care for customers. You think about their experience constantly and push the team to get the details right.
Strong communication with both front-end and back-end engineers.
Experience taking problems (rather than strict guidelines) and developing strong solutions.
The ability to recognise what needs to be done, and just as importantly, what doesn't need to be done right now.
A talent for spinning many plates and context switching between competing demands without dropping quality.
Confidence in making decisions quickly, even with incomplete information.
Confidence tackling large-scale, ambiguous tasks and breaking them into something shippable.
An empathetic approach to collaboration.
Love for being the glue that holds cross-functional teams together.

Experience working on apps serving multiple markets or languages.
Familiarity with energy, utilities, or other regulated industries.

About Allica Bank
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
Department Description
Allica Bank aims to provide Expert Banking for Business Britain by providing excellent customer experience and pioneering technology solutions to facilitate this.
The Autonomous Lending tribe runs across multiple business lines including Credit Operations and Underwriting, with a mission to build AI-first lending origination journeys, automating origination capabilities, data flows, and underwriting and operational workflow management.
The tribe is a critical driver for Allica to continue to realise its vision of providing a market leading relationship-based banking experience, at a speed and cost to serve the rest of the market cannot match.
Role Description
The Product Owner will lead the work to define, deliver and manage AI-enabled products across our lending journeys, bringing together product design and thinking with a strong working knowledge of what today’s AI can and cannot do.
You will be accountable for the roadmap of your team and for the full product lifecycle: discovery and design, day-to-day delivery, launch and adoption by colleagues and customers, and how risks are addressed once a product is live. You will aim to build robust, automated and well-governed systems and processes that enable us to move quickly and innovate our lending and financing products in the SME banking market.
Whilst a lot of the market aims to avoid the complex nature of SME businesses, we are going for it head on, designing simple and efficient solutions to the most complex problems in the market to provide excellent and efficient customer experience. We aim for our external view of the lending product, as well as our internal systems to be the best in market which will allow us to scale quickly to serve more UK SMEs, while doing so in a cost-effective manner.
Principal Accountabilities

With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.
Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.
Your mission As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration.
You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving.
You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners.
Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next.
You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful.
You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges.
You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases.
You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics.
Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development.
You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback.
Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions.
What you need to succeed You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering.
You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations.
You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers.
You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences.
You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs.
You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most.
You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden.
You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows.
Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus.
Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus.
Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions.
Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.
At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.
The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for.

That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.
We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.
This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.
You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. On one side, the site: supervisors, field engineers and site managers working in conditions where an app has about five seconds to prove it's worth opening.

On the other, the office: project directors, commercial directors and quantity surveyors who need to trust what they're looking at enough to make a call on it. Value only appears when those two sides connect, and that connection is what we build.
Depending on where you're strongest and what the business needs, you might own the field side, the commercial side, or the seam between them. In every case the standard is the same: real adoption by people who have no obligation to use us, and a concrete outcome for the project as a result.
You'll also be at the front of how AI shows up in our products. A meaningful part of our ambition depends on AI doing genuinely hard things well in a domain with very little tolerance for confident nonsense, the stakes for our users are commercial and often contractual. You'll be the person who decides where AI earns its place, and where it doesn't.
Team
You'll be part of our Product team, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and our consultancy delivery teams, who are on live projects every day and are the sharpest feedback loop any product team could ask for. You'll also work closely with growth and customer success to make sure what we build reaches the people who need it.

Own the outcome: You will own a product area end to end, the problem, the strategy, the roadmap and the results. You'll define what success looks like in customer and commercial terms, and you'll be honest about whether we hit it.
Get close to the problem, on both sides: You'll spend real time on live projects, in the site cabin and in the commercial meeting, with our consultancy teams, and in the data. You'll build a deeper understanding of how a construction project actually runs, and of the commercial machinery behind it, than most people in our industry have, and use it to make sharp calls about what to build and what to refuse.

SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.
By catering to both fans and rightsholders, we're powering a new, open entertainment ecosystem where fans have effortless access to experiences, and teams, venues, and shows have seamless access to their audiences. Because everyone should expect more from ticketing.
We are looking for Product Managers with varying levels of experience to join SeatGeek’s R&D team. This role will own SeatGeek's Catalog — the foundational data layer that defines what exists on our platform.

Every event a fan can shop, every seat they can buy, every venue map they navigate, and every attribute that makes a ticket more than a dot on a map starts here. Catalog is the ground truth that everything else — shopping, fulfillment, and eventually attending the event — is built on top of.
This is a high-leverage, deeply cross-functional role. When the catalog is accurate, complete, and fresh, fans trust what they see and every downstream experience just works. When it isn't, the cracks show up everywhere.

Your mission is to make SeatGeek's understanding of the live event world the most accurate, comprehensive, and richly detailed in the industry — from getting brand-new onsales live the moment they're announced, to modeling complex venues seat-by-seat, to capturing the features and attributes that help fans find exactly the right spot.
SeatGeek is where passionate fans and ambitious builders come together to reshape live entertainment, and if you're excited to build the data foundation that powers it all, we'd love to hear from you.

About Customer Portal
Customer Portal exists to make Veriff's product sell itself. The Portal serves two purposes. It allows our customers to operate Veriff products — setting up and configuring products, consulting verification session details, reporting issues.

And it is a privileged surface for customers to discover, try, buy and expand through a seamless self-serve experience, connecting product usage, onboarding and growth in one place. It unites forces with GTM to automate acquisition, upsell, cross-sell and retention, with end-to-end ownership of the customer persona. The area is evolving fast.

What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.
The shape of this role
This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership — distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.
As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff's commercial model and revenue drivers.
Run disciplined, continuous discovery with customers, and translate it into well-defined problem statements and a sequenced roadmap.
Make transparent prioritisation and trade-off calls across product ambition, technical sustainability and business urgency — especially where capability gaps mean we cannot do everything at once.
Define success metrics before building, and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not output.
Partner as a credible peer to Engineering, GTM, Fraud Ops and Design. Be the connective tissue that turns internal expertise into a customer-facing product.
Own launch as a discipline from the start — internal platform releases and external GTM — not a milestone at the end.
Set and uphold the product-craft bar. Mentor PMs and, in time, build and lead the team.
Champion AI internally, implementing new best practices for faster product discovery and delivery.

You are a product leader who has earned authority through the quality of your thinking rather than a title.
You have owned a product area end-to-end
From strategy through discovery, delivery and launch. You are equally comfortable in the messy front end of a problem and in the discipline of shipping.
You are looking for the step where your impact starts to come through others, and you are excited that this role begins as an individual leader and grows into managing a team — not the other way around.
You think commercially
You instinctively connect what you build to how the business grows, and you explain the “why” behind a product bet in terms of revenue, retention and customer trust, not just features and flows.
You run discovery as a continuous discipline
You get close to customers, including demanding enterprise accounts, and you can tell the difference between what they ask for and what they actually need.
You turn that into sharp problem statements and a phased roadmap where every step delivers a real customer outcome.
You prioritise ruthlessly and transparently
When there are more good ideas than capacity, you make the hard calls about what not to do, and you can articulate the reasoning.
You define success before you build. When something goes wrong, you own it without deflection and change how you work as a result.
You lead through influence, not authority
You build credibility with engineering, go-to-market, design and operations partners as a genuine peer, and you reach good decisions with people who do not report to you.
You stay calm under uncertainty, create space for views that differ from your own, and commit gracefully once a call is made.
You raise the people around you
You set a high craft bar through your own work, share your thinking generously and give specific, useful feedback.
You are motivated by building and leading a team over time, with a realistic understanding that management is a different job — one focused on developing people and multiplying impact, not doing all the work yourself.
You stay current on your craft
You take pride in tracking how product management is evolving, and you consistently find time to experiment and fold what works into your practice.

Deine Rolle & dein Impact ⚡️
Du gibst unseren Produkten ihre Daseinsberechtigung und machst Innovationen für unsere Community greifbar. Als Schnittstelle zwischen Trendgespür, Performance-Zahlen und operativer Umsetzung verwandelst du Marktchancen in erfolgreiche Launches. Du steuerst die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (Einkauf/Ops, Brand/Marketing, Sales/Vertrieb) sowie externen Partnern wie Produzenten, Lieferanten und Dufthäusern.
Das bringst du mit 🤝
Erfahrung: Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Product Management / New Product Development (NPD), idealerweise bei einer D2C-Brand, im FMCG- oder Beauty-Umfeld.
Skincare-Erfahrung: Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Know-how im Bereich Skincare/Hautpflege sind ein großes Plus.
Trend-Gespür & Customer Focus: Leidenschaft für Beauty-Trends, ein feines Gespür für Konsumentenbedürfnisse und den Anspruch, bestehende Produkte noch besser zu machen.
Analytische Stärke: Souveräner Umgang mit Markt- und Sales-Zahlen (KPIs, Umsatz- & Absatzdaten) sowie die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete Strategien abzuleiten.
Schnittstellen- & Partner-Know-how: Erfahrung in der Koordination externer Partner (Lieferanten, Dufthäuser, Hersteller) und internen Stakeholdern.
Prozess- & Projektstärke: Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit starkem Hands-on-Mentalität.

Du wächst mit der stetigen Skalierung unseres Produktportfolios und der Erschließung neuer Beauty-Kategorien mit. Je tiefer du in Trendanalysen, Lieferanten-Netzwerke und datengetriebenes Portfolio-Management eintauchst, desto mehr Verantwortung übernimmst du bei strategischen Launches, internationalen Sortimentsanpassungen und zukunftsweisenden Produktinnovationen.

Own product outcomes from discovery through delivery: talk to customers, frame the real problem, decide what we build, and ship it to production.
Shape the solution end to end, from the customer problem to the interface people actually use, making a complex domain feel simple.
Get hands-on with the data and the planning logic: query it yourself, understand how our forecasting and optimization models behave, and troubleshoot when something's off.
Put AI to work on real customer problems. Weave it deep into how spare-parts planning gets done as a core part of the product, not a bolt-on.
Stay close to our customers, from a world-famous motorsport team to global leaders in industrial automation and packaging, and turn what you learn into roadmap and measurable impact.

Must-Have
3+ years in product management for B2B, enterprise, or technical/data-heavy products, owning outcomes from discovery to delivery.
Comfortable getting hands-on with data: querying it yourself, understanding how optimization and forecasting models work, and troubleshooting rather than treating the system as a black box.
Genuinely fluent with AI: you know how to weave it into solving real customer problems, not just how to chat with it.
A talent for simplification: you turn complex, technical concepts into clear, usable product and can shape that experience yourself.
A self-starter with customers and ambiguity: you seek out users firsthand and are energized by being the first dedicated PM rather than following a finished playbook.
Fluent in English.
Great If You Also Bring
Strong working German: a real plus for getting close to our customers.
Exposure to ERP, supply chain, manufacturing, or other complex industrial domains.
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment.

Die Bildungsplanung des Kantons Zürich erhebt bildungsstatistische Daten für mehrere Kantone. Diese bilden eine wichtige Grundlage für die Planung und Steuerung des Bildungswesens.
Als Projektleiter und Product Owner übernimmst du die operative Gesamtverantwortung für die Entwicklung des «BISTA-Portals» und verbindest Projektsteuerung, Produktentwicklung und Requirements Engineering.
### Deine Aufgaben ###
* Du planst, steuerst und priorisierst die Projekt- und Produktentwicklung inklusive Roadmap, Backlog, Ressourcen und Budget.
* Du erhebst, analysierst und strukturierst fachliche, prozessuale und datenseitige Anforderungen und überführst diese in umsetzbare Lösungen.
* Du koordinierst das interdisziplinäre Umsetzungsteam sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Stakeholdern und externen Partnern.
* Du förderst eine agile und selbstorganisierte Zusammenarbeit und verstehst es, in komplexen Situationen Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Entscheidungswege zu klären und gemeinsam mit dem Team weiterzuentwickeln.
* Du konzipierst und moderierst Workshops und Entscheidungsprozesse und begleitest UX, technische Konzeption, Testing und fachliche Abnahme.
* Du verantwortest Projektcontrolling, Risikomanagement und Reporting und stellst die strategische Einbettung des Projekts innerhalb der Direktion sicher.
* Du betreust zudem die bestehenden Applikationen BISS3/4 bis zu deren Ablösung.
### Dein Profil ###
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Projektleitung, Product Ownership oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle im digitalen Umfeld.

* Erfahrung mit agilen Vorgehensweisen, insbesondere Scrum und Kanban.
* Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie ein gutes Verständnis für komplexe organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
* Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder lateralen Führung.
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und resultatorientierte Arbeitsweise.
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.
* Kenntnisse in Azure DevOps, HERMES oder entsprechende Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil.

Wir bieten dir eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem interdisziplinären Team. Dich erwarten ein zentral gelegener Arbeitsplatz in Zürich, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen sowie zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen und Sozialleistungen nach kantonalen Richtlinien.

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption.
